Interface Action<T>

Type Parameters:
T - The type of the result returned by the run method.
All Known Subinterfaces:
DirtyAction<T>, DirtyVoidAction, VoidAction
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractAction, ConstructorAction
public interface Action<T>
Represents an action that can be executed and undone by either the app or the user affecting the scene. Implementations of the interface provide the logic for executing and undoing the action themselves.

This interface has multiple other versions for return type clarity.

Lehlogonolo Poole
